answer: Roche achieved 100% sustainable electricity coverage across its sites. Combined Scope 1 and 2 emissions fell from 266,859 tonnes in 2024 to 175,051 tonnes in 2025 (reported as 34%), and 100% coverage is to be maintained throughout 2025–2029.
subject: Roche Group
scope_boundary: Roche sites under the disclosed target boundary; Chugai excluded
